scripts.dev: npm run build -w @app/shared && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run dev -w @app/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
